name: Prism Current
edition: River Prism / Currentworks Water + Fire + Trees
scope: Preserves Rotunda, water, controls, combat and saved progress. Adds independent event-driven volume fire, smoke and embers. Preloads fire texture/programs inside cancellable loading before soundtrack playback; repeated preparation shares its pending work. Cosmetic effects do not change damage rules. Fire 0.1.3 exercises density, geometry and first drawing into a disposable loading target before audio; no extra render target remains in gameplay. Trees 0.1.3 adds eight seeded bank-side trees with host-clock wind and bounded detail levels. AR and Mothership hide the trees; the existing water, fire, controls and combat rules are unchanged.
